systems.name: OpenClaw
systems.license_source: LICENSE file in repo root (contents API) + README badge; REST license field returned NOASSERTION, file wins
systems.description: Open-source AI assistant on owner hardware: gateway, channels (20+), models as swappable plugins, nodes, automation, tools, VPS.
systems.notes: Broadest surface of the eight; gateway/credential/channel concepts are reference only. No fork: Aetherius owns its gateway (P21).

systems.name: Lobster
systems.license_source: LICENSE file in repo root (contents API)
systems.description: OpenClaw-native workflow shell: typed JSON-first pipelines, approval gates, local-first, macros, no new auth surface.
systems.notes: Closest behavioral overlap with P19; kept study-only because P19 is proven and complete. No second workflow engine.

systems.name: ClawHub
systems.license_source: LICENSE file in repo root (contents API) + README badge

systems.notes: Skill discovery/search and package trust metadata are the transferable ideas; registry mechanics stay first-party (P19).

systems.name: ClickClack
systems.license_source: LICENSE file in repo root (contents API)
systems.description: Self-hostable team chat (Go server, Svelte app, CLI, TS SDK): channels, bots/agents, WebSocket live updates, SQLite/Postgres.
systems.notes: Transport/state patterns inform P27; no comms dependency adopted.

systems.name: ClawSweeper
systems.license_source: LICENSE file in repo root (contents API)
systems.description: Conservative maintenance bot: scheduled/event issue-PR review, durable reports, marker comments, guarded repair/automerge; readiness is not merge authority.
systems.notes: Readiness-vs-authority separation matches our approval architecture; steward automation maps to P16.

systems.name: CrabFleet
systems.license_source: LICENSE file in repo root (contents API)
systems.description: Remote-desktop access over VNC (Mac/Linux/Windows connectors, browser companion): negotiated video/audio, clipboard, file transfer, relays.
systems.notes: CORRECTION: not an agent fleet controller. Remote-desktop reach maps to P21 device adapters + P30 remote nodes. No fleet semantics to reuse.

systems.name: CrabBox
systems.license_source: LICENSE file in repo root (contents API) + README badge
systems.description: Run repo commands on remote/SSH/container targets: warm workspaces, diff sync, streaming, teardown. Trust model is explicit: trusted single user/team, NOT adversarial isolation.
systems.notes: Runner mechanics inform P20; their trust model is weaker than ours (no hostile-tenant isolation), so isolation must be added, not copied.

systems.name: OctoPool
systems.license_source: LICENSE file in repo root (contents API)
systems.description: Self-hosted GitHub read relay: Cloudflare Worker + D1 cache, pooled PATs/GitHub Apps, token-free transports, budget-aware routing.
systems.notes: Relay/cache mechanics inform P30; pooled-credential model requires owner authorization, scoped tokens, and no rate-limit/ToS evasion.
